summary.text: Craig Shubert is the Republican candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 34 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat Derrick Hall.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he is a former journalist and global business development leader who was elected the 56th mayor of the City of Hudson.

paragraphs.text: Craig Shubert earned a bachelor's degree from Iowa State University in 1980 and has worked in business development.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described his background as print and broadcast journalism followed by a career as a global business development leader.
He sought the Republican nomination for Ohio House District 37 in 2018, finishing second with 16.8 percent of the primary vote behind Mike Rasor.

Shubert said his campaign priorities are making Ohio a better place to start and run a business, income and property tax relief particularly for seniors, and greater government transparency, including around data centers.
